name: Disperse
description: The sector widening as it crosses the sheet: a splinter on one side, half a circle on the other.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 250deg at 50% 100%, #000 0 @calc(16 + 174 * @x / @X)deg, transparent @calc(16 + 174 * @x / @X)deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from 250deg at 50% 100%, #000 0 @calc(16 + 174 * @x / @X)deg, transparent @calc(16 + 174 * @x / @X)deg 360deg); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
